executionRulings: Ruling: continue this reversible diagnostic inline without another approval/workflow menu -- established user authorization covers sequential audit work -- cost if wrong: diagnostic time and disposable local files; no product change is assumed.

Ruling: test a dedicated single-sample terminal HDR buffer,not mutate samples on an already allocated target -- preserves installed renderer attachment semantics and original scene MSAA -- cost if wrong:8bytes/pixel extra temporary GPU storage; product adoption needs exact parity and benefit.

Ruling: require exact HDR/depth/RGBA equality and baseline controls before timings/product implementation -- earlier empty-lens and asteroid-noise candidates changed pixels despite plausible equivalence -- cost if wrong: safe-but-not-bit-exact optimizations remain unaccepted.

Ruling: complete real-scene8/4matrix in v2 and cover terminal0 in an isolated valid fixture before adoption -- forced whole-app0 fails in the existing atmosphere path,while product initialization is fixed8 -- cost if wrong: no claim of whole-app0 support; that baseline limitation remains a separate observation.

Ruling: implement two EffectPass subclasses behind the existing pair factory,not a combined composer pass -- preserves10pass order,composer swap/mask/enable semantics and existing effect wiring -- cost if wrong: a small paired input-routing abstraction and about7.03MiB extra color storage at720p.

Ruling: preserve raw pixel/PNG buffers locally with hashes and embed reports,sources,queries and logs in the tracked archive -- repeated large identical image variants would bloat the repository -- cost if wrong: independent pixel recomputation on another PC needs the local artifacts or a rerun; the archive alone checks hashes/statistics,not unembedded pixels.
